% / regression fixture.
% Three short paragraphs followed by a forced page break (\eject), then a
% single \bye-terminated trailing page. With in force, \eject is
% \par\penalty-10000 with NO implicit \vfil; the body box is stretched to
% \vsize via NORMAL parskip stretch only, so paragraph baselines distribute
% (with a high but finite glue-set ratio). Used by
% tests/test_interpreter_integration.py::test_eject_distributes_paragraphs
% to check that our DVI y-coordinates stay within 1 pt of the MiKTeX baseline.
\vsize=300pt
\noindent Para1\par
\noindent Para2\par
\noindent Para3\par
\eject
\noindent Final\par
\bye
